title: Australia – Salmon
outcome_basis: HM:arb_req_no_auth + WTO_ds18sum: Australia issued AQIS July 1999 lifting import ban; June 2000 mutual agreement
notes: Settled bilaterally before authorisation; classic "threat-induced compliance"

title: EC – Hormones (US)
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted + imp_req_date populated + WTO_ds26: US retaliation applied 1999; EC never complied (still unresolved 2010+, MoU 2009)
notes: Authorisation $116.8M; US tariffs imposed; EC refused to lift hormone ban

title: EC – Bananas III
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted + imp_req_date populated + WTO_ds27: EC Tariff-Only regime 1 Jan 2006 + 2009 Geneva Agreement
notes: Authorisation $191.4M; US/Ecuador tariffs imposed; EC eventually adopted tariff-only regime under retaliation pressure

title: Brazil – Aircraft
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted + imp_req_date populated + WTO_ds46: PROEX III brought into compliance Aug 2001 DSB adoption
notes: CAN $344M authorisation; Brazil modified PROEX three times under retaliation threat; final PROEX III ruled compliant

title: EC – Hormones (Canada)
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted + imp_req_date populated + WTO_ds48: parallel to DS26; EC never complied with hormones ruling
notes: Canada $11.3M authorisation; same fundamental EC non-compliance as DS26

title: Canada – Dairy
outcome_basis: HM:arb_susp_date populated + WTO_ds103: Canada eliminated Special Class 5 milk pricing
notes: Settled during arb suspension; Canada changed measures

title: US – FSC
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted $4.043B + imp_req_date 2003 + WTO_ds108: US replaced FSC with ETI; ETI also struck down; EC tariffs applied 2004-2006; only AJCA 2004 partially compliant
notes: Largest authorisation in WTO history; US compliance contested for years

title: Canada – Dairy
outcome_basis: Duplicate of DS103 with NZ as complainant; same outcome
notes: Linked to DS103

title: US – 1916 Act (EC)
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted but unspecified value + WTO_ds136: 1916 Antidumping Act repealed Dec 2004 by US Congress
notes: US complied just after authorisation by repealing the Act; pending claims resolved

title: US – Section 110(5) Copyright
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted but arb suspended Feb 2002 + WTO_ds160: 2003 mutual agreement on compensation; US paid lump sum
notes: Settled with compensation rather than compliance per se; EC accepted ~€3.3M lump sum

title: US – 1916 Act (Japan)
outcome_basis: HM:arb_susp_date Feb 2002 + Act repealed Dec 2004 + WTO_ds162: parallel to DS136
notes: Same Act repeal as DS136

title: US – Byrd Amendment
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted Formula + imp_req_date + imp_date populated + WTO_ds217: Byrd Amendment repealed Feb 2006 (Deficit Reduction Act)
notes: Multiple complainants retaliated; US Congress repealed amendment under pressure

title: Canada – Aircraft Credits
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted but no retaliation applied + WTO_ds222: Canada Account program modified to compliance
notes: Canada changed Canada Account guidelines

title: US – Byrd Amendment
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted + imp_req_date + imp_date populated + WTO_ds234: parallel to DS217; same Feb 2006 repeal
notes: Linked to DS217

title: Japan – Apples
outcome_basis: HM:arb_susp_date 38203 + WTO_ds245: Japan implemented new measures, mutual agreement Aug 2005
notes: Japan changed apple import quarantine rules

title: US – Softwood Lumber IV
outcome_basis: HM:arb_susp_date + WTO_ds257: Settled by Oct 2006 Softwood Lumber Agreement
notes: Multi-dispute negotiated settlement; all SLB disputes resolved bilaterally

title: US – Softwood Lumber V
outcome_basis: HM:arb_susp_date + WTO_ds264: Settled by Oct 2006 SLA
notes: Same SLA package

title: US – Upland Cotton
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted 40056 + WTO_ds267: US never fully removed GSM-102 export credit guarantees; Brazil/US 2014 MoU only after years more pressure
notes: 2005 auth but compliance partial/late; coded as 24-mo non-compliance

title: US – Oil Country Tubular Goods
outcome_basis: HM:arb_susp_date + WTO_ds268: US zeroing methodology disputes settled across many cases
notes: Argentina pursued; settled via methodology changes

title: US – Softwood Lumber VI
outcome_basis: HM:arb_susp_date + WTO_ds277: Part of Oct 2006 SLA package
notes: Same SLA

title: US – Gambling Services
outcome_basis: HM:auth_granted $21M + WTO_ds285: US never modified gambling restrictions; Antigua never retaliated effectively (small economy)
notes: Authorised but compliance not achieved; tiny complainant ineffective

title: EC – Biotech
outcome_basis: HM:arb_susp_date Feb 2008 + WTO_ds291: EC adopted new biotech approval process, complainants stood down
notes: Settled to procedural improvements

title: US – Zeroing (EC)
outcome_basis: HM:arb_susp_date Sep 2010 + WTO_ds294: US modified zeroing methodology across many cases through 2012
